'''Rhea''' - wife of Caar al Thorin al Toren.

== History==
She lived around {{ab|1150}}. She met Caar al Thorin in the [[Borderlands]], she did not know who he was and he wed her setting the skein in the Pattern that led to his death by Rhea's hand and the fall of [[Aleth-Loriel]]. She killed herself before his tomb. {{ref/book|1|19}}
